positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Embedded Linux software engineer
- Coding in C++, Python, and C
- Using yocto and bitbake to compile for embedded Linux targets
- IPC between processes with D-Bus and sockets

Using Nucleus RTOS on an arm processor
- Fixing bugs in the VPN stack of the RTOS

Using GnuTLS to upgrade radios from TLS v1.0 to TLS v1.2

Working on L2/MAC layer protocol code to enable new feature
- Interacting with MAC layer software and FGPA to enable new feature

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Technical lead for connected car application on a team of 6+ developers
- Multi threaded C++11 application with the GCC toolchain using QT for the human machine interface (HMI) running on a QNX powered car head unit
- Using GitHub enterprise for revision control
- Using libcurl for Internet connectivity
- Working with a RESTful API to send and receive data from the backend in JSON
- Using libcrypto for securing data to send/receive encrypted information over the Internet
- Using Valgrind to debug memory leaks and identify unintended memory growth
- Using GDB to debug crash dumps and screen freeze issues
- Gained an understanding of the HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) standard used for streaming audio from the Internet
- Working with various internal and external teams to ship production level software in a vehicle under tight timelines
